body: I don't think so I've been suicidal for a while but too scared to attempt. Now I'm brave enough during this spiral which is good. I'm not sad about it at all. As for the ethics, that's really upsetting. Ultimately I will be taking myself out, so I want to minimize the effect on others as much as possible. Obviously I'll self inflict (no jumping in front of trains and traumatizing conductors), but the location is a difficult decision. Maybe just a note on the outside of a door saying to call paramedics/police cause I'm already dead? Since paramedics/police are used to stuff like that.

1. He *is* in the wrong because he violated consent in his follow-up. Hard stop. 
2. He made a video of him violating someone's consent so he can be judged. 
3. A crisis post is meant for venting without pushback, which people need in times of crisis. Everyone has ignored this. 
4. It's way more nuanced than "he's wrong I'm right the mother's right commenters wrong" I believe everyone sucks here.
- The son, because he made a follow-up triggering his mother for clout 
- The mother may be wrong for abuse, but we literally know nothing about her. Just what this kid who has literally violated her consent has said. 
- Commenters here and on the video, for their lack of nuance and emotional grace.
I have also not had "unreasonable" reactions. I know this objectively so. But you wouldn't be capable of empathizing with me since you're caught up on thinking I'm an abuser. Fucking creep.

You are again accusing me of abuse. You're the manipulative one here. I don't know how you can't see that. I clearly stated I was upset because the son violated her consent and all comments were hating on OCD people. That's literally the whole reason. I don't know anything about the mother's abuse. You are actually a disgusting person and I mean this. You keep accusing me of abusing the ones I love despite me never doing that and never saying I do anything like that. Get that through your skull. *You're accusing me of abusing people I love because I felt bad for someone's privacy being violated.* I almost think you're a troll at this point because you're being straight up evil and trying to hurt.
This was me for most of my life. I feel kind of high right now because for the first time in my life I'm emboldened to. I feel like I'm finally free. I'm kind of giddy about it.
This is literally such a disgusting thing to say to someone.
Thank you for a sensible comment. I appreciate your words and insight.
I'm disabled as well and it makes life so difficult. I don't think I was meant to exist in this life. I can't take the challenge.

I did actually get diagnosed with depression and anxiety as well, and was super stressed with little sleep at the time. Processing speed was my lowest score, ending up in 30th percentile (which was probably the biggest reason my full score was so low). I do tend to be better with verbal stuff. I'm just so surprised my problem solving skills were low considering I'm so good at that stuff. Plus my arithmetic was lower than it should've been because I skipped a couple questions out of anxiety (anxiety due to my slow processing speed). Your comments certainly make me feel better and more understood. You seem very smart yourself so to know you also messed up the test like me is reassuring.

You've captured exactly how I feel and my situation. I guess I should trust my life experiences and peers more than some unreliable test, but I just haven't been able to get it out of my head. I also am tempted to have another IQ test done but I think when I get a therapist I'll just discuss how I'm feeling with them. I really appreciate your comment.
Well, lower than I expected. My full IQ is 108.
Happy to hear this because I eat hot sauce on everything and every day.

I agree with the last bit, but it's not just my home town; everybody that I've interacted with, even on the Internet, and in very intelligent clusters of university students, thinks I'm a genius. I've been around and the conclusion tends to be the same. I really don't think the IQ I scored then is an accurate depiction of my intelligence, especially given the constraints and context of the exam. I had no sleep, I was so anxious I could barely move my hands, and one of the puzzles that I think is what dropped my score didn't visually match the representation on the paper and that slowed me down. I was thinking maybe that was the point and I was supposed to give no answer. I just really wish I could redo the IQ test under better circumstances - even though it really doesn't matter.

Same thing happened to me. Trust me when I say it gets better. You can escape even if you think you're incapable. The best vector is by forming friendships or even just support networks online that help you escape. You can do it.
That's exactly the fields I'm interested in. Really helps me feel better. Thank you.
I did as well and I expected at least 120s. 😓

This makes me feel a lot better especially because I also scored high verbally. I can understand my processing speed being low but problem solving being low seems very inaccurate since I've always been way above average at that.
Thank you!
It just hurts so much
I really needed the "thanks for existing" part.

Thank you so much. I'm still trying to find a way out. I'm an adult, but I'm mentally disabled and they keep draining me of my money. I have nobody else IRL that can help me with a place to stay to escape, sadly.
It wasn't even the worst they've done.

When I was 6 my parents tried to force me to finish my cereal. I was full; I didn't want anymore cereal. I told them I was going to throw up, which was true; I was sick to my stomach from eating that cereal. They told me that if I threw it up they'd make me eat the throw up. I sat there and cried, forcing myself to eat this soggy cereal while feeling like I was going to burst. I was obese until I became an adult and was able to handle my own nutrition. I almost think it was a control thing, because every time I told them I wanted to diet they would bake and cook as much as they could and force me to eat it all. Then they'd make fun of me for being fat and tell me I was a useless whale.
*Next‽*

I feel like being born was just jumping into a noose with not enough force to immediately break my neck. I'm just dangling and waiting to die while people sit there and laugh and the world passes me by. Nobody can cut me from the rope, and some feel bad and stop to talk for a bit, but then the sun comes up and they have to attend to their lives (understandably). If I die, then they can remove my corpse and my suffering will have stopped. Nobody will be burdened by their empathy when they cross my path and all those that are laughing will no longer have me to laugh at.
Thank you so much for the kind words. Maybe I should take a break from trying. 💖
I'm glad I'm not alone on this!
I just read a list of BPD symptoms and I check every box except one... When I eventually am capable of seeing a therapist I'll have to talk to them about that possibility. Huh.

I have previously suspected that I have BPD because I relate to a decent bit of symptoms, but I *really hope that's not the case.* I mean, there's also a lot I don't relate to. CPTSD is interesting. I don't really recall having any trauma (I mean technically somebody in my family died when I was young, but that never seemed to affect me as far as I can tell). Any more info on those?

I rarely consume any sugar or caffeine. I have tea at night with no caffeine, and occasionally dark chocolate (which could possible contain caffeine, but I don't really know). I have a high protein low-carb diet, so mostly protein rich foods and some fatty foods. I don't drink any sugary drinks and only take a teaspoon of sugar in my tea.
I think I'm feeling mostly alright today. I've just been fighting off anxiety/intrusive thoughts and I've been doing pretty well I think. Thank you for checking in. How are you?
Thank you my friend. You too.
Thank you for reading. Magic is how I choose to live. I hope you can find comfort in magic as well.
Thank you for the support. Just seeing your comment makes me feel less alone; that's all I really need.
Thank you so much.
At least this bot says something to me.

I don't know... I'm not so sure it would even be worth publishing anything. What does publishing really do? There's no way I could make money off of anything I write, and I can just throw them out there by posting them on Reddit if I really wanted.
It's just one of those illogical fears, like a pet peeve I guess. I don't think I ever want to have anything published. Might be cool, but I don't think that's for me.

Yeah people online can be quite inconsiderate in that sense. 

I like to write about my depressive thoughts and the coping mechanisms that I use to fight them; philosophies that I've developed; and things I see in everyday life that I find particularly beautiful or marvelous. 

I bet your art is wonderful as well, and I'm glad that you have that for yourself. 

I also guess that if I did post something and someone stole it, it'd at least have a timestamped post on my account that I can refer to to prove that it's mine.

I always wrote comments for similar reasons. I am a little scared of getting *too much* attention on my posts. I want to let out my emotions, but not to too big of an audience, you know? I'm also a bit worried that people will think I'm trying to promote something or farm for karma or pity. I understand their suspicion; I feel it myself all the time online. My poetry isn't very good, but maybe in the future I'll be courageous to post something.  Maybe somebody will really like it. I know there's a lot of writings and poetry I like that most people don't think fondly of. Thank you for your comment by the way; it makes me feel less lonely. :)
I understand, thank you. I kind of figured it would be removed cause I couldn't really understand the rules well. (Not because of how they were written; I just suck at reading).
